stem: Tyler wants to add a closing sentence to his paper. Which sentence could BEST follow sentence 40 and help bring his paper to a close?

options.label: A
options.text: Subway Cat seemed happy to be on his own once again.

options.label: B
options.text: He was the subway cat, and now he was worried about having to find his own food.

options.label: C
options.text: He carted his silly little self straight to the door.

options.label: D
options.text: And that is now the end of the story about the brave little subway cat I met one day.
